questionText: How do you create profile-specific configuration in Spring Boot?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can create a correctly named profile file, activate it externally, and predict which base and profile values become effective.

claims.statement: Spring Boot loads profile-specific application-{profile} config files in addition to the base file and lets their matching keys override non-profile values.
spring.profiles.active and spring.profiles.default cannot be placed inside profile-specific documents or documents activated by spring.config.activate.on-profile.
When several profiles are active, Spring Boot applies profile-specific configuration in the active profile order and later matching values can override earlier ones.

examples.title: Load the exact base and development property files with dev active

validation.command: Run the Java 17 Spring Boot 3.3.1 fixture with --spring.profiles.active=dev and the exact base/dev settings
validation.expected: The dev port and log level win while the base application name and timeout remain available

visuals.title: Base configuration followed by the selected profile overlay

notes: The Mermaid flow parsed and rendered in headless Chrome with a compact left-to-right path.

review.notes: Profile naming, activation restrictions, overlay order, and multiple-profile behavior were checked against official Spring Boot documentation; the base/dev example passed.
